name: Fuzzbadger
description:
Close kin of the Chic Badgers, these animals make their dwelling in the Snezhnayan interior.
Fuzzbadgers are clad in long, thick, and soft fur, allowing them to travel as they please, even in the coldest of climes.
Despite their fluffy appearance, they possess a fierce temperament and never back down, even when facing massive foes. Such is the law of survival on the snowy plains: Do not tread upon the territory of a Fuzzbadger carelessly, lest they show their claws and swiftly make an example of any trespassers.
